name: flowcommit
description: Transactional safety runtime and control plane for enterprise RPA and AI agents.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @flowcommit/core && npm run build -w @flowcommit/sdk && npm run build -w @flowcommit/db && npm run build -w @flowcommit/policy && npm run build -w @flowcommit/evidence && npm run build -w @flowcommit/runtime && npm run build -w @flowcommit/api && npm run build -w @flowcommit/worker && npm run build -w @flowcommit/cli && npm run build -w @flowcommit/studio
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d postgres redis temporal temporal-ui opa minio && npm run dev -w @flowcommit/api
